# OMT Services (One More Thing)

> A modern, hands-on consulting service helping you organize essential information and create clear access plans for the people you trust. OMT Services also provides mobile notary services, traveling to clients to complete signings in person.

## Business
- Name: One More Thing (OMT Services)
- Contact: AngieMay@omtservices.com
- Service area: Plano TX, Frisco TX, Allen TX, and Richardson TX

## What We Do
- Mobile notary services (we come to you)
- Organizing essential personal and household information
- Creating clear access plans for trusted family members and contacts
- Guided intake sessions to prepare documents and information
